description: This file implements the HTTP/2 client transport for gRPC in Go, including connection management, stream creation, frame handling, flow control, keepalive, and error handling.

classes.name: http2Client
classes.description: Implements the gRPC HTTP/2 client transport, managing connection, streams, frames, flow control, and keepalive.

methods.name: NewHTTP2Client
methods.description: Constructs a new HTTP/2 client transport, establishing connection, performing handshake, and starting reader and writer goroutines.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Initiates shutdown of the transport, sending GOAWAY, closing connection, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: GracefulClose
methods.description: Sets transport to drain mode, preventing new streams and closing when active streams finish.

methods.name: NewStream
methods.description: Creates a new gRPC stream, handling headers, flow control, and stream registration.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data frames for a stream, handling flow control and message framing.

methods.name: handleData
methods.description: Processes incoming data frames, updating flow control, and dispatching data to streams.

methods.name: handleRSTStream
methods.description: Handles RST_STREAM frames, terminating streams with appropriate status.

methods.name: handleSettings
methods.description: Processes SETTINGS frames, updating stream limits and flow control parameters.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Handles PING frames, responding with ACKs or updating BDP estimators.

methods.name: handleGoAway
methods.description: Processes GOAWAY frames, updating connection state and closing streams as needed.

methods.name: operateHeaders
methods.description: Processes incoming header frames, parsing headers, and updating stream state.

methods.name: readServerPreface
methods.description: Reads and verifies the initial server preface and settings frame.

methods.name: reader
methods.description: Main goroutine reading frames from network, dispatching to handlers, and handling errors.

methods.name: keepalive
methods.description: Maintains connection liveness by periodically sending PING frames.

methods.name: getOutFlowWindow
methods.description: Retrieves current outbound flow control window size.
